PathOfBuilding2.Notes:
Early Maps non crit Make sure to upgrade all your gear and look for evasion/energy shield items. Always upgrade gloves!!! Use Orb of Transmutation and Augmentation until you hit a good blue item. Then Regal and Exakt it. You are looking for +to melee skills and # to # damage to attacks. Alternatively, you can Gamble from the vendor too. Skill LEVEL is THE most IMPORTANT stat for Hollow Palm. EVERY level is 10% DPS. Make sure to get some on gloves/amulet and try to keep highest level up.
When should I start taking crit nodes? Since every point of 10 ES on your items is 0.1% crit chance, I would recommend to swap to crit with AT LEAST 500 energy shield on items
If you do any Cold Damage and have a Polcirklen Sapphire Ring use it for Freeze/Herald of Ice clear and Way of the Mountain!
If you have a lot of flat damage over 50 to attacks to fire and cold you can replace Lightning attunement with deliberation
If you struggle with single target, replace Innervate with Concentrated effect
IMPORTANT FOR LATE GAME Since we are not Invoker, We need SPIRIT, preferably 50 Spirit to reserve all Spirit gems, otherweise drop charge regulation.
Ascendancy order: 1. Way of the Stonefist 2. Runic Meridians for early resistance 3. Way of the Moutain if you can freeze/pin, if you have Polcirklen Sapphire Ring 4. Up to you
